we present the first approach to structured light based 3D scanning that is able to operate outdoors in strong ambient light by distributing light in a way that it is always better than the state-of-the-art.

by using a scanning light source and a light concentration strategy, it is possible to achieve 3D scanning in sunlight, and that the proposed approach can be used for 3D scanning of outdoor scenes under strong ambient illumination.
